headline: Five penny stocks drop heavily over the past six months

modes.bear: Heavy losses and lack of liquidity mean investors can get trapped with no exit options during sharp downtrends.
modes.bull: Deep pullbacks in low-priced stocks can occasionally offer speculative entry points if business fundamentals improve.
modes.simple: Penny stocks are very cheap shares that can swing wildly. When they drop heavily, getting your money back can be very difficult.

summary: Five penny stocks, including Urja Global, have experienced sharp declines of up to 68 percent over the last six months. Such steep drawdowns in micro-cap shares highlight the extreme volatility and high risk associated with low-priced equities. Retail investors often face severe capital erosion when momentum fades in such illiquid counters. Understanding these risks helps prevent substantial losses in speculative stock holdings.
why_it_matters: Penny stock volatility can erase your invested capital quickly.

headline: Urja Global releases Q2 financial results
hook: Urja Global reports September quarter financials
summary: Urja Global Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the NSE. The filing provides the company's performance metrics for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail investors can access the detailed balance sheet and profit-loss statement through the exchange portal.
why_it_matters: Review the company's profitability and debt levels in the latest filing.
